Loud, smoky, drugs
Jan 2017 • Friends
It seems that drug taking is accepted in Vietnam. Certainly here no one minds what you do. I saw people inhaling helium from balloons and openly smoking joints. There were quite a few aggressive people here which was sad.

The staff are nice, the drinks are cheap, the location is good but I probably wouldn't go back.

People who find drug taking upsetting should certainly avoid this place. It is common elsewhere too in this are of HCM City

Typical City experience
Sep 2016 • Solo
While looking on TripAdvisor I went looking for this cafe to try and find somewhere to eat for dinner. When I found it I sat and had a couple of beers as Aussies do. I had a good chat with the manager lady and a local. They were good fun and very nice people. It's a great place to sit and watch the traffic go by. There is something about watching the passing parade, it is so much fun. 
The only disappointing part was when leaving and paying the bill, going on previous comments that it is cheap to drink here is not really correct. 
Just check prices before you drink. 
As far as a good place to eat, they don't have any food. But they said they can get from a local restaurant if you want. So I can't say about the quality of the food.
